datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2014 and spatially mapped to administrative units in Malawi. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases derived from standardized IPC methodology applied to assess population vulnerability to food insecurity.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity conditions.
